title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-12-21
lineage: MR > C > D > CDR > EAC (secure) > CE2K (minor cleanup) > CD Wave > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of decent clarity captures a solid Fillmore ’69 set highlighted by a monster Not Fade Away and a stellar Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The stereo sound‑board source offers a clear, well‑balanced mix for a 1969 performance. Musically the show shines with an electrifying Not Fade Away, a powerful Black Peter and strong Rider and Other One moments, though the truncated Good Lovin' into The Other One and a tired‑sounding Cumberland Blues keep it from being flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (especially NFA, Black Peter, Rider) and note a good‑quality soundboard mix; only a few mention missing songs or minor slip‑ups, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo soundboard with a decent 1969 mix; clear overall but occasional abrupt cut (Not Fade Away) and some tape‑end quirks. No major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A single‑set, ~75‑minute show that moves from a brief Rider into a strong Black Peter and a monster Not Fade Away, then jumps from Good Lovin' straight into The Other One and ends with Cumberland Blues; the flow is energetic but the abrupt song changes and missing first six numbers are noted.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar solo on Not Fade Away receives high praise, along with a nice Rider lead; he also exchanges thanks with the audience at the close.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard work is highlighted as a strong point in The Other One.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum solo leading into The Other One is noted as a highlight, though some feel the later Cumberland Blues drumming sounds tired.
